name: alpaca
about: An alpaca: about 90 cm at the shoulder, a long neck, a small head with long ears, thick wool on the body and the neck.
sources: An adult alpaca is 81 to 99 cm high at the shoulders (withers) and weighs 48 to 90 kg (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alpaca).

The colors and the thick wool of the body, the neck and the legs (shape): from photos of a brown alpaca (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Berlin_Tierpark_Friedrichsfelde_12-2015_img01_Alpaca.jpg), not a measurement.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
